baseline: Installed Repentance 1.7.9b; current pinned wiki descriptions distinguished from local tuning.
attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors; paraphrased pinned Clotty and Hopper infoboxes and stage evidence.

supports: I.Blob replaces Clotty or Clot with a 1% chance.
Clotty source environments omit Depths; Clot includes Depths/Dank Depths. Grilled lists Burning Basement and Chest.
Afterbirth-onward normal Hopper has a 60% Flaming Hopper substitution specifically in Burning Basement.
Installed authored room evidence for direct Hopper/Flaming Hopper bands 0–2; direct encounters remain distinct from conditional replacements.

implementation: External floor_variant weights select a deterministic context on a separate stream. Band 0 has Standard weight 2 and Scorched weight 1; later bands stay Standard.

External replace_monster rules substitute independently selected natural actors once, after composition. Conditions include band and optional variant; chances use basis points. Original slot identities are retained for auditing.
Extra threat is reserved before selection regardless of roll outcome or chance 0. Source actor caps and population slots apply. The stream does not consume combat, reward or geometry randomness.
Existing residents and immutable run snapshots never reroll. Explicit/debug/offspring spawning bypasses room substitution. Overlapping rules, linked/grouped bodies and hazards are rejected.

Clot is directly eligible in bands 1–3. Ordinary Clotty is restricted to bands 1 and 3. Grilled is eligible only in Scorched opening pursuit rooms. I.Blob is reachable by the two 1% source substitutions.
The Scorched context has sparse local ground deposits and an expedition-screen name. The Original renderer, topology, terrain heights, story sites, roads and rivers remain unchanged.
adaptations: Scorched Washes is a Burning Basement encounter-context analogue, not a reconstruction of its authored rooms, total roster or full environmental art.

The 2:1 context weights, extra threat of 1, encounter weights/caps, procedural appearances and HP/timing conversions are local DeathWard tuning. Only the 1% and 60% replacement rates are source numbers.
Opening Clotty/Clot source presence is intentionally introduced later, in Broken Quarry. Grilled Chest presence awaits a dedicated late encounter; it is not flattened into every Storm Cut room.
Reservation slightly reduces source-family selection frequency: these percentages apply after a source actor is selected, not to all enemies, rooms or floors.
Separate source-slot streams can correlate identity changes under deliberately edited source pools; determinism is established, not a claim of matching Isaac RNG.

synthetic_rates.scope: Synthetic seeded slot fixtures, not 30000 generated floors.

floor_variants.geometry_check: Identical generated seed-42 topology and canyon heightfield under forced Standard and Scorched snapshots; Scorched has 16 deposits.

evidence.account: Rourke; full generated populations and source-slot provenance retained.
evidence.forced_residents: Separate 100% override fixture yields eight I.Blob residents with correct 96 HP, legal placement and persistent re-entry. This is not evidence for default 1% reachability.
evidence.stage_audits: 393-floor discovery reached all 25 enabled identities. Final bounded regression keeps 128 broad floors, rare-route fixtures and missing formation/hop activation supplements: 170 floors total.

limitations: No new full behavior port is certified complete. Existing family attack/item/status/numeric/visual gaps remain in the maintained checklist.
Timed burning, relevant item producers, full flooded contexts, Grilled inheritance and exact morph HP policy still need work.

Source caps apply before substitution; target caps from independent pool entries are not a second global quota. Current shipped pursuit groups have only one specialist, preserving the Flaming Hopper cap.
Ash deposits use bounded edge/center terrain tests and are cosmetic. They do not implement fire hazards, flooded art or a complete Burning Basement theme.

Inspected captures show mixed-room bodies and local deposits in Original style; coarse repeated deposit shapes and similar procedural enemy silhouettes remain art limitations. No all-angle visual certification or controlled performance/mixed-floor balance conclusion is made.
